# Fix fuzzer

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw



<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- New Features
  - Added a test runner CLI that accepts files, directories, or stdin, with debug and sbrk-gas options, and prints disassembly on demand.
  - Streamlined disassembly CLI supporting multiple files and an SPI mode flag.

- Bug Fixes
  - Gas never becomes negative after subtraction; underflow is handled safely.
  - Prevented out-of-bounds write when program code is empty.

- Chores
  - Added npm scripts (fuzz, test:w3f, web, update-version) and updated CI workflow command.
  - Updated dependencies and removed a deprecated CLI tool.

```suggestion
  // Read from stdin
  let buffer = '';
  const flush = () => {
    if (!buffer.trim()) {
      buffer = '';
      return;
    }
    const json = JSON.parse(buffer);
    const input = {
      registers: read(json, 'initial-regs').map(x => BigInt(x)),
      pc: read(json, 'initial-pc'),
      pageMap: asPageMap(read(json, 'initial-page-map')),
      memory: asChunks(read(json, 'initial-memory')),
      gas: BigInt(read(json, 'initial-gas')),
      program: read(json, 'program'),
    };
    const exe = prepareProgram(
      InputKind.Generic,
      HasMetadata.No,
      input.program,
      input.registers,
      input.pageMap,
      input.memory,
      []
    );
    const result = runProgram(
      exe,
      input.gas,
      input.pc,
      options.isDebug,
      options.useSbrkGas
    );

    json['expected-pc'] = result.pc;
    json['expected-gas'] = result.gas;
    json['expected-status'] = statusAsString(result.status);
    json['expected-regs'] = result.registers;
    json['expected-page-fault-address'] = result.exitCode;
    buffer = '';

    console.log(JSON.stringify(json));
    console.log();
  };

  process.stdin.on('data', (data) => {
    buffer += data;
    if (buffer.endsWith("\n\n")) {
      flush();
    }
  });

  process.stdin.on('end', flush);
}
```
